713:t_163:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I will fight!」

713:t_163:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This is the life I chose!!」

713:t_164:0.en:
$$レド$$
「You can't break free of the shackles called a mission. You're the same as I used to be!」

713:t_164:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Living should be much freer than that! Understand it!」

713:t_164:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I threw everything away to come this far. It's too late to change how I live now!」

713:t_164:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Why can't you see that doing so makes you and everyone around you unhappy?!」

713:t_164:4.en:
$$レド$$
「If you can't stop yourself, then I... we will stop you! Just like I was stopped once!!」

713:t_164:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then come! Show me what a man who strayed from the herd can do!!」

713:t_165:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Don't think a mere soldier can beat me, a general!」

713:t_165:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm a human being before I'm a soldier. And you're a coward before you're a general. I don't intend to lose to the likes of you.」

713:t_165:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「For a man who doesn't even have the courage to change himself, even this is too lenient!」

713:t_165:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't you dare say you can't do what a man like me managed to do, you coward!」

713:t_165:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Mocking my way of life is the same as mocking the souls I have taken...」

713:t_165:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you have time for empty talk, then come! I, a lowly soldier, will re-educate you, General!!」

713:t_166:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So you've come this far, regretting how you lived yet unable to change it.」

713:t_166:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I have already moved past my doubts.」

713:t_166:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Wrong! You have only put a lid on your hesitating heart!」

713:t_166:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Lost for words? Then I'll carve defeat into you and end your long journey of regret!」

713:t_166:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「When my fight ends...! That will mean the day they perish!」

713:t_166:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will keep fighting until that day! It is how I repay the souls that fell!」

713:t_166:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Piling up sins like that, you are who I used to be! That's why I'll stop you!!」

713:t_167:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, $$異能生存体$$! If you overcome causality, I will surpass your very existence!」

713:t_167:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「You're fighting a battle you don't even want to fight. You're no different from how I used to be.」

713:t_167:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「It seems you, too, know nothing but fighting.」

713:t_167:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is the meaning of my life.」

713:t_167:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If that's what you believe, fine.」

713:t_167:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Not that I intend to keep you company.」

713:t_168:0.en:
$$桂$$
「If you wanted to take down the $$御使い$$s, you should've just said so. I would have lent you a hand.」

713:t_168:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It's not too late even now. Come to me, $$特異点$$.」

713:t_168:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will need you as well, as our final trump card.」

713:t_168:3.en:
$$桂$$
「I bet if I say no, you'll use force anyway, right?」

713:t_168:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Exactly! I cannot afford to choose my methods!」

713:t_168:5.en:
$$桂$$
「We're out of room, too! Don't think you're the only special one!」

713:t_168:6.en:
$$桂$$
「I hate it! Thugs who force their way through with power!」

713:t_168:7.en:
$$桂$$
「In the end, you've become the same as the people you hate most!」

713:t_169:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$! Recognize your own mission!」

713:t_169:1.en:
$n
「I know that without you telling me.」

713:t_169:2.en:
$n
「But I don't think it's fine to sacrifice everything in the name of a mission, like you do!」

713:t_169:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you going to run away?!」

713:t_169:4.en:
$n
「You have no right to decide that!」

713:t_169:5.en:
$n
「I'm the one who decides how to use my life! I won't let you have your way, you who fought by taking other people's lives!」

713:t_169:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is my fight! Your $$スフィア$$... I will take it!!」

713:t_170:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$悲しみの乙女$$. If you want to end the fighting, offer that power to me.」

713:t_170:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ lives on within me, along with his hatred. Yours, too...」

713:t_170:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My life is my own! I will not hand over myself or my $$スフィア$$ to your selfish logic!」

713:t_170:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You are one who strikes down the $$御使い$$s, yet you chose the same methods they did! You are my enemy!」

713:t_170:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I expected that answer! As I thought, a $$スフィア$$ can only be taken by force!」

713:t_170:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Taking is what breeds sorrow! I will stop that!!」

713:t_171:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You've come, $$傷だらけの獅子$$! That power...」

713:t_171:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't need any extra words! Neither of us is the type to be stopped by words. You know that!」

713:t_171:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't thank a guy you're about to punch! You're taking the wind out of me!」

713:t_171:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go, $$ヴィルダーク$$! I'll punch you hard enough to stop that idiotic fight of yours!」

713:t_171:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I won't stop! I will take your $$スフィア$$ and challenge the $$御使い$$s!!」

713:t_172:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I heard it from that woman. $$ヴァイシュラバ$$ apparently thought highly of a man like you.」

713:t_172:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm honored. ...Is what I'd like to say, but getting praised by a villain won't earn me a single cent.」

713:t_172:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm not exactly respectable enough to talk about him or you, either.」

713:t_172:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, you still come at me, $$揺れる天秤$$.」

713:t_172:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's not a matter of good or evil. I just don't like the way you do things.」

713:t_172:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So that is your unbreakable will.」

713:t_172:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I don't need catchphrases like that. Come on, $$ヴィルダーク$$.」

713:t_172:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Go on ahead to the other world and hold a reunion with $$ガイオウ$$!」

713:t_172:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「No! You're going to be my $$メッセンジャー$$ and tell him how I lived!!」
